draft.text: You came in because you have been having trouble swallowing solid foods like sandwiches for about 4 to 5 weeks.
You feel like something is stuck in your throat when you try to swallow.
We did not find any problems during the exam.
There were no signs of pain, weight loss, or other issues related to your throat or chest.
Your symptoms could be due to a problem with how your throat or esophagus works.
This could be something like a blockage or a problem with the muscles that help you swallow.
The doctor will arrange for you to have an upper endoscopy or a barium swallow study.
These tests will help check for any structural or muscle-related issues that might be causing your trouble swallowing.
